title: French Pork Gratin
description: A classic French dish combining pork with creamy and crispy elements.
instructions: Season pork shoulder with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Sear pork in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Transfer pork to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook cured bacon until crispy.
Remove bacon from skillet and chop into pieces.
Add garlic to skillet and sauté for 1 minute.
Sprinkle flour over garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Gradually add creme fraiche to skillet, whisking constantly.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Stir in grated cheese until melted.
Pour cheesy sauce over pork in baking dish.
Top pork with crispy bacon, crispy onions, and additional grated cheese.
Bake in preheated oven for 30-40 minutes or until pork is cooked through.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
